WITH budget_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    e.event_id,
    e.location,
    CASE 
      WHEN b.amount = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE (b.spent - b.amount) / CAST(b.amount AS REAL)
    END AS ratio
  FROM budget b
  JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
),
event_avg_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    event_id,
    location,
    AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM budget_ratios
  GROUP BY event_id, location
),
ranked_events AS (
  SELECT 
    event_id,
    location,
    avg_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY avg_ratio DESC NULLS LAST) as rank
  FROM event_avg_ratios
)
SELECT 
  event_id,
  location,
  avg_ratio,
  rank
FROM ranked_events
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY location, rank, event_id

assumptions.assumption: Budget lines with amount = 0 are excluded from ratio calculation (treated as NULL); we average only valid ratios for each event. Events with no valid ratios are ranked last.
Only events with at least one budget entry are included. Events without any budget entries are not shown.
'Top 3 events' means ranks 1, 2, and 3 within each location. Tied events share a rank; if two events tie for rank 1, the next event is rank 3, and both ties appear in results.
